description.narrative: a) Formulate a strengthened and coherent regional framework for IMSWM in AMS to support ASEAN Vision 2040 and ASCC Blueprint 2025.b) Accelerate investment for IMSWM projects.c) Establish an online multi-stakeholder knowledge sharing and collaboration platform for AMS.d) Strengthen IMSWM capacity in AMS and AMS-Korea knowledge exchange, through policy, capacity development, knowledge and technology transfer, and investment mobilization across the region.
